kurz: Rösti turns crisp when the starch plays along: boiled potatoes from the day before, a hot pan, patience.
bild_im_kopf: Like a cake of potato strands that the starch glues together and the heat crusts on the outside.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Boil potatoes in their skins the day before and let them cool
schluesselmomente.warum: Cooled starch firms up. The shreds do not fall apart or stick into a mash.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Grate coarsely and salt only just before frying
schluesselmomente.warum: Salt draws out water. Salted too early, the shreds turn wet.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Press flat in hot butter or clarified butter
schluesselmomente.warum: Contact with the hot surface and fat: the underside browns evenly.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Do not move it until the edge releases, then turn
schluesselmomente.warum: The crust releases by itself when it is ready. Before that, it tears.
